# Andrew Ratnikov

> Full-stack developer specializing in AI automations and custom integrations for businesses that have outgrown no-code/low-code tools like Make and n8n.

Andrew builds custom code (Node.js, Python, or whatever the job needs) when a no-code integration platform can't reach a system or hits a hard limit. He works with direct clients and agencies/dev shops looking to subcontract.
